title: Preconception visit note
text:
# Preconception visit note
Synthetic patient: {name}. Facility: Hospital B.
The coordination record lists an outstanding preconception assessment. This note records a visit and a request to reconcile prior documentation. It does not contain a completed screening result or a treatment recommendation.
Clinical interpretation and policy confirmation remain with the clinician.

title: Pregnancy registration form
text:
# Pregnancy registration form - synthetic copy
Patient: {name}. Receiving facility: Hospital B.
This is the source-document copy for the pregnancy registration journey. Gestational dating and window dates must be read from the server calculator, not inferred from this document.
Earlier Hospital A records are available only after the clearly labelled simulated exchange. This form neither confirms nor closes any obligation.
